name: World Radio
description: Internet radio: find stations by name, country, genre or language and play them on the World Radio page, with favorites. Sound plays only while that page is open in the Desktop; it does not play on a speaker by itself, and it has no podcasts or recording.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.find_stations: Find internet radio stations by name, country, genre or language, without playing one. Gives the top 15, numbered, with country, bitrate and stream address.
tools.play_station: Play an internet radio station on the World Radio page. The page must be open in the Desktop to hear it.
tools.stop: Stop the internet radio on the World Radio page.
tools.now_playing: Say which radio station World Radio is set to, and whether its page is open.
tools.favorites: List the saved favorite radio stations.
tools.add_favorite: Save a radio station to the favorites. With no station, saves the one playing now.
tools.remove_favorite: Remove a radio station from the favorites, by its name or number.

find_stations: what jazz radio stations are there
favorites: what are my favorite radio stations
add_favorite: save this radio station to my favorites
remove_favorite: remove KEXP from my radio favorites

consent: Station search asks radio-browser.info (de1.api.radio-browser.info, all.api.radio-browser.info) and sends only the search words. A station you pick streams straight to the World Radio page from that station's own server, which sees your internet address as any website does. Nothing else about you is sent; your favorites stay in World Radio's data folder on this computer.
